```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

#create temp profile
```{r}
# Days 0 to 42
days <- 0:42

# Control treatment (always 0°C)
control_temp <- rep(0, length(days))
control <- data.frame(
  Day = days,
  Treatment = "Control",
  Temperature = control_temp
)

# +3.5 C treatment
temp_treatment <- c(
  rep(0, 11),                # Days 0–10
  seq(0.5, 3.5, by = 0.5),   # Days 11–17 (ramp up)
  rep(3.5, 13),              # Days 18–30 (hold)
  seq(3.0, 0, by = -0.5),    # Days 31–37 (ramp down)
  rep(0, 5)                  # Days 38–42 (hold at 0)
)

treatment <- data.frame(
  Day = days,
  Treatment = "+3.5 C",
  Temperature = temp_treatment
)

# Combine both treatments
temperature_profile <- rbind(control, treatment)
```

# plot it
```{r}
temperature_profile$Treatment <- factor(temperature_profile$Treatment, levels = c("Control", "+3.5 C"))

ggplot(temperature_profile, aes(x = Day, y = Temperature, color = Treatment)) +
  geom_line(aes(linetype = Treatment), size = 1.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 10, linetype = "dotted", color = "black", size = 1) +  # Line at x = 11
  geom_vline(xintercept = 30, linetype = "dotted", color = "black", size = 1) +  # Line at x = 31
  annotate("text",x = 15, y = 1.75,label = "0.5°C/day",color = "black",size = 4,fontface = "italic",angle = 75) +
  labs(x = "Day", y = expression(Delta~"Temperature (°C)"), color = "", linetype="") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Control" = "black", "+3.5 C" = "#086788"), labels = c("Control", expression("+3.5"~degree*C))) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Control" = "dashed", "+3.5 C" = "solid"), labels = c("Control", expression("+3.5"~degree*C))) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        text = element_text(size = 18), 
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18))

#ggsave(here("experiment", "figures", "dissertation", "Atkinson2020.png"), width = 5.5, height = 4)
```

# Let's do another MHW scenario
```{r}
# Define days from 0 to 16
days <- 0:19

# Control treatment (always 0°C)
control_temp <- rep(0, length(days))
control <- data.frame(
  Day = days,
  Treatment = "Control",
  Temperature = control_temp
)

# +3.5°C treatment: step changes
# Day 0–2: 3.5°C
# Day 3–6: 0°C
# Day 7–9: 3.5°C
# Day 10–14: 0°C

treatment_temp <- c(
  rep(0, 5),      # Days 0–1
  rep(4, 3),    # Days 2–4
  rep(0, 4),      # Days 5–8
  rep(4, 3),    # Days 9–11
  rep(0, 5)       # Days 12–16
)

treatment <- data.frame(
  Day = days,
  Treatment = "+4 C",
  Temperature = treatment_temp
)

# Combine both treatments
temperature_profile <- rbind(control, treatment)
```

# Plot it
```{r}
# Ensure correct factor level order for plotting (Control plotted second, +4 C first)
temperature_profile$Treatment <- factor(
  temperature_profile$Treatment,
  levels = c("+4 C", "Control")  # Plot: +4 C first, Control second
)

# Plot
ggplot() +
  # Plot +4 C treatment first
  geom_step(
    data = subset(temperature_profile, Treatment == "+4 C"),
    aes(x = Day, y = Temperature, color = Treatment, linetype = Treatment),
    size = 1.2
  ) +
  # Plot Control treatment second (on top)
  geom_step(
    data = subset(temperature_profile, Treatment == "Control"),
    aes(x = Day, y = Temperature, color = Treatment, linetype = Treatment),
    size = 1.2
  ) +
  # Manual scales for color and linetype
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("+4 C" = "#086788", "Control" = "black"),
    labels = c(expression("+4"~degree*C), "Control")
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("+4 C" = "solid", "Control" = "dashed"),
    labels = c(expression("+4"~degree*C), "Control")
  ) +
  # Reorder the legend so that Control appears first
  #guides() +
  labs(
    x = "Time (d)",
    y = expression(Delta~"Temperature (°C)"),
    color = "", linetype = ""
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    text = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18)
  )

#ggsave(here("experiment", "figures", "dissertation", "He2021.png"), width = 5.5, height = 4)
```
